text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference. One original fictional adult woman, age 23. Short chin-length dark brown bob with loose side part and one side tucked behind ear, fair neutral skin, soft oval face, large brown eyes, straight thick brows, natural pink lips, cream sleeveless crewneck ribbed knit. Cream sleeveless ribbed crewneck top, high-waisted dark navy wide-leg jeans and white canvas sneakers. Preserve the distinct small mole below her left eye (image right). Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
